title: Data assimilation section
description: Configuration for the surface OI and upper-air assimilation chain.

do_surface.description: If true (default), Run surface OI chain.

do_upper_air.description: If true, the upper-air 3D-Var chain (UpperAir family with OopsVar) is added after the surface OI chain. Set to false to run surface DA only (CANARI chain without 3D-Var), which is useful for refining the surface analysis independently or for surface-only experiments.
